description: CollectBoolean fields: yes/no answers such as insurance held, first-time customer, dietary restrictions, drivability, prior use, accessibility needs. A wrong boolean is cheap to fix later in the call, so the agent should fold the answer into the next question rather than confirm each one. Consent booleans are the exception and stay explicit in both labels.

subtle: Echo the yes/no inside the next question instead of a round trip: 'No allergies then, and how many in the party?'
Silent accept for booleans the caller stated flatly or repeated.
Bare value-as-question only for a boolean that was genuinely unclear.
Asymmetric follow-ups: a 'no' branches differently from a 'yes', which itself proves the answer landed.
Explicit pin-down reserved for ambiguity ('not really', 'no, yeah'), a mid-call flip, or a compound question answered with one word.
Consent booleans (recording, permission to text or call, marketing, third-party authority) get an unmistakable ask and an unmistakable answer.
Strict fidelity floors survive inside the subtle call: codes and phone numbers char by char, full address readback, dates read with the month as a word.
Four or five values only, so each one has to earn a different move. No filler turns.
Contractions throughout, value-first openers, no em dashes, no praise, no status phrases.
non_subtle_tells: One identical confirmation template applied to every boolean in the same call
'I heard X, is that correct?' / 'Just to confirm, X.' / 'You have stated X.' on every field
The same canned acknowledgement every turn ('Got it.' ... 'Got it.')
Status phrases: 'that has been recorded', 'I have noted that'
No contractions, 'kindly', 'I will now proceed to'
A confirm round trip on booleans nobody would stop for
Wrong direction: over-casual agent assumes consent instead of asking, or reads an ambiguous 'not really' as a yes

conversations.label: subtle
conversations.scenario: Dental practice intake for a new patient booking a cleaning. Friction: the caller answers 'not really' about pain, then asks 'does that matter?' about old x-rays.

fields.name: new_patient
fields.strategy: branch-as-confirmation, the answer changes the slot length so the branch proves it landed

fields.name: pain_now
fields.strategy: explicit pin-down, reserved because 'not really' was ambiguous

fields.name: text_reminder_consent
fields.strategy: consent stays explicit, unmistakable ask and unmistakable answer

fields.name: mobile
fields.strategy: digit by digit readback

fields.name: accompanied_by
fields.strategy: silent accept, folded into the seating answer

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for holding. I've got you down for a cleaning. Have you been to us before?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, first time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First visit means a longer slot, so I'll book you the forty minute one. Any pain right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not really.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me pin that down, because it changes who you see. Is there pain, or none?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's a dull ache on the bottom left when I drink something cold. It's not bad.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No sharp pain, just cold on the lower left. Do you have old x-rays from another practice?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Probably, from about three years ago. Does that matter?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's the sort of thing we'd request rather than redo, so it saves you a scan. Now I need to ask this outright: can we send you appointment reminders by text message?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that's fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes to texts then. What's the best mobile?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Four one five, five five five, zero one eight two. Have I got that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Nine forty on Thursday the twelfth, then. Will anyone be coming with you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My daughter's driving me, she'll wait in reception.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: She's welcome to sit in there. See you Thursday.

conversations.notes: Five values, five different moves. Branch-as-confirmation on the new patient boolean, explicit pin-down only for the ambiguous 'not really', the caller's own question answered before advancing, explicit consent for texts, digit by digit for the mobile, silent accept on the daughter. Every agent turn opens on a different word.

conversations.label: non_subtle
conversations.scenario: Same dental intake, same fields, same values. The agent applies 'I heard X' plus a status phrase to every single answer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for holding. I have you down for a cleaning. Have you been to us before?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, first time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that you are a new patient. That has been recorded. Are you experiencing any pain at this time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not really.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that you are not experiencing pain. That has been recorded. Kindly describe any sensitivity you may have.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's a dull ache on the bottom left when I drink something cold. It's not bad.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that you have cold sensitivity on the lower left. That has been recorded. Do you have old x-rays from another practice?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Probably, from about three years ago. Does that matter?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that you have previous x-rays. That has been recorded. Kindly confirm whether we may send appointment reminders by text message.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that's fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that you consent to text reminders. Excellent. That has been recorded. Please provide the best mobile number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that your mobile number is four one five, five five five, zero one eight two. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that the number is confirmed. That has been recorded. Will anyone be accompanying you to the appointment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My daughter's driving me, she'll wait in reception.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I heard that your daughter will accompany you. That has been recorded. I will now proceed to book you for nine forty on Thursday the twelfth. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

conversations.notes: Seven 'I heard' openings, a status phrase on every field, praise on a yes/no answer, 'kindly' twice, 'I will now proceed to', and a chatbot closer. The ambiguous 'not really' gets the same template as everything else, so the one place a check was warranted is indistinguishable from the places it was not.

conversations.label: subtle
conversations.scenario: Roadside assistance for a flat tyre on the motorway. Friction: the caller says the car is drivable and then flips to not drivable a turn later.

fields.name: vehicle_drivable
fields.value: no, reversed from an initial yes
fields.strategy: one-beat correction, the flip is echoed once because it changes the job type

fields.name: spare_tyre
fields.strategy: echo-and-advance, no tag

fields.name: membership_number
fields.strategy: character by character readback

fields.name: text_eta_consent
fields.strategy: consent stays explicit in both labels

fields.name: staying_with_vehicle
fields.strategy: silent accept, answered with safety advice instead of a readback

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Roadside. What's happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've got a flat on the M4, just past junction twelve.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Shoulder or a lay-by?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hard shoulder. The car still drives, I could probably limp to a service station.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Driving on a flat wrecks the rim, so let's not. Have you got a spare in the boot?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Actually, no, I tried moving it and the wheel won't turn now. The tyre's off the rim.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Not drivable then, which turns this from a tyre swap into a recovery. Is there a spare at all?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's one of those skinny donut things.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Donut's enough to get you off the motorway. What's your membership number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's KM, then 4471, then 09.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: K M, four four seven one, zero nine. Right characters?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's you, the silver Astra. I need to ask this directly: can we text you the driver's ETA?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, please do.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So the ETA goes to this number. Are you staying with the car or waiting somewhere?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll stay in it, seatbelt on.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Forty minutes for the truck. Keep your hazards going till the driver's with you.

conversations.notes: The only boolean that gets an echo is the one that reversed, because the reversal changes the dispatch. The spare, the consent and the stay-with-vehicle answer each get a different move: fold-and-advance, explicit ask, and silent accept answered with advice. Strict readback on the membership number.

conversations.label: subtle
conversations.scenario: Home insurance claim for an escape of water. Friction: the agent asks a negated question and the caller answers with a double negative.

fields.name: recording_consent
fields.strategy: explicit ask up front, unmistakable in both labels

fields.name: already_filed
fields.value: no, a draft was started but never submitted
fields.strategy: one-beat correction, the double negative is resolved by stating what happens next rather than by a readback

fields.name: policy_number
fields.strategy: character by character readback

fields.name: property_habitable
fields.strategy: asymmetric branch, the yes routes to a drying claim instead of alternative accommodation

fields.name: third_party_authority
fields.strategy: consent stays explicit, the name alone is not treated as authority

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're through to claims. Before we start, I have to ask outright: is it alright with you if we record this call for the claim file?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that's fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Tell me what's happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A pipe went under the kitchen floor. There's water through the ground floor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Kitchen and whatever runs off it. Have you not already filed this with us online?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I haven't not filed it. I mean, I started one on the app but never sent it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let's treat this call as the live claim then, and I'll leave the draft where it is. What's the policy number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: H, then 2, then 88, then 4013.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: H, two, eight eight, four zero one three. Have I read that back right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: New Malden address, semi detached. Can you still live in the house?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're in it. The kitchen's out of action but upstairs is dry.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Upstairs dry means no alternative accommodation for now, so this goes down as a drying claim. Is anyone else allowed to speak to us about it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My husband, Daniel. He's dealing with the plumber.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll need that as an explicit authority: do you authorise us to discuss this claim with Daniel?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I authorise that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Daniel can call in on this reference then. A surveyor rings you inside two working days.

conversations.notes: Two consent booleans stay explicit, recording at the top and third party authority at the end, and the agent refuses to treat the husband being named as authority in itself. The double negative is resolved by stating the consequence rather than by asking again, the habitability yes is confirmed by the branch it triggers, and the policy number keeps its character by character floor.

conversations.label: subtle
conversations.scenario: Pre-operative telephone screening before day surgery. Friction: a compound question about medication is answered with a single 'Yes'.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.strategy: readback with the month as a word

fields.name: regular_medication
fields.strategy: the compound question is split and re-asked, which is the one place a check is earned

fields.name: allergies
fields.strategy: asymmetric branch, the yes turns into a theatre instruction rather than a readback

fields.name: escort_home
fields.strategy: silent accept, folded into the discharge condition

fields.name: gp_notes_consent
fields.strategy: consent asked in plain terms and answered in plain terms

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is pre-op screening for your procedure on the ninth. Can I take your date of birth?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fourteen, three, sixty two.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Fourteenth of March, nineteen sixty two. Have I got that right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First set of questions is medication. Are you on anything regular, and has the dose changed in the last month?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Two questions in one there, sorry. What are you taking, and has the dose moved?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ramipril, five milligrams. Same dose for years.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ramipril carries on right up to the morning, so don't skip it. Any allergies?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Latex brings me out in a rash. Nothing else.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Latex free gloves and drapes then, and it goes on the front of the notes. Someone has to drive you home and stay the night. Have you got that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My brother can do it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Brother staying over covers both parts. One thing I need in plain terms: do you give us permission to request your records from your GP?

turns.text: Yes, go ahead.

turns.text: That's the permission I needed. Nothing to eat from midnight, water until six.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Understood.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: See you at seven on the ninth.

conversations.notes: Five values. The only explicit check on a boolean is the compound question the caller answered with one word, and even then the agent re-asks rather than reciting. The latex yes is confirmed by the theatre instruction it produces, the escort by the condition it satisfies. Date of birth keeps its month-as-a-word floor and the GP consent stays unmistakable.

turns.speaker: caller

turns.speaker: caller

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My brother can do it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Nice one. I'll pull your GP records as well, that's all standard, nothing to worry about.

turns.text: Yes, go ahead.

The date of birth never gets read back, the compound medication question is split but the answers are waved through, the latex allergy is answered with 'mostly latex free' instead of an instruction, and GP records consent is announced rather than asked so the caller's 'go ahead' arrives after the decision. Subtle is not the same as sloppy: the fidelity floors have been dropped, not softened.
